title: The end stool, a coffee poured
logline: Gully's counter, the end stool empty, and Gully's hand pouring a coffee for it anyway, from above. Eleven days before the first back. The shop keeps the place the way the beach did.

panels.composition: From above: a shop counter with an empty end stool and a stocky man's hand pouring coffee into a cup set before it, the corkboard's edge.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, seen from above, a shop counter with an empty end stool and a stocky man's hand pouring coffee into a cup set before it, a corkboard's edge, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
